information.description:
Large Air Drone (about the size of a small car). A car-sized air drone that can guard 25m past a building's walls. Flares let it dodge one explosive a Round. LL/IR/UV camera, radar/sonar and radar detector, a machine gun (Autofire, Machine Gun 4) with 60 Armor-Piercing or Tracer rounds, plus one of: a Very Heavy Pistol (8 Armor-Piercing or Explosive), a Shrieker (8 shots), or a Double-Boom with a smoke and a teargas grenade.

Cost: 20,000eb
MOVE: 6
HP: 30
SP: 11
CN: 14
Counter: DV21 E/S Tech, 5 min to counter

Item Compendium (2070) • Gear & Goods

Art: Neon Hub fan art of the Cyberpunk 2077 setting (CD PROJEKT RED), free to use, not for sale.
